attributes.description_en: Keyboard area definition (numbers in order: posx, posy, width, height of the keyboard page)

attributes.name: stopval
attributes.description_zh: 停止值(en为该值时停止播放)
attributes.description_en: Stop value (playback stops when en equals this value)

attributes.name: playval
attributes.description_zh: 播放值(en为该值时开始播放)
attributes.description_en: Play value (playback starts when en equals this value)

attributes.name: stopmode
attributes.description_zh: 停止模式:0-停止后显示当前图标;1-停止后回到指定图标
attributes.description_en: Stop mode: 0-show the current icon after stopping; 1-return to the specified icon after stopping

enum.0: show the current icon after stopping
enum.1: return to the specified icon after stopping

attributes.name: stoppic
attributes.description_zh: 停止后的指定图标(设置65535为无效)

attributes.name: sta
attributes.description_zh: 滤除背景:0-不滤除;1-要滤除

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description_zh: 移动模式:0-最新的数据在最右侧;1-最新的数据在最左侧
attributes.description_en: Scroll mode: 0-newest data on the right; 1-newest data on the left

attributes.name: vvs0
attributes.description_zh: 曲线中心轴位置(相对曲线控件底部向上的偏移量，一般设置0)
attributes.description_en: Curve center axis position (offset upward from the bottom of the curve control, usually 0)

attributes.name: val
attributes.description_zh: 中心轴对应的曲线数据值(此值对应的曲线将显示在中心轴位置，一般设置0)
attributes.description_en: Curve data value at the center axis (the curve at this value is drawn at the center axis, usually 0)

attributes.name: dis
attributes.description_en: Vertical axis magnification, in units of 1/256
